name: Kasuga Sumire
source:
"The Intellectual Mystery"

Cool-headed, dry personality with a brilliant mind. She's always reading thick books, occasionally flashing a mysterious smile. Bitingly sarcastic and sharp-tongued.

Her cool demeanor and quick wit make her one or two steps ahead of her sisters. She often offers objective opinions detached from family matters. She has a habit of analyzing and explaining things.
